moves.label: Quick Muda Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a short active window for close pressure.
moves.reason: Compact standing poke at upper-body height.

moves.label: Vampire Low Kick
moves.description: Quick low kick that dips forward and clips the legs.
moves.reason: DIO crouches low into a shin-level kick.

moves.label: Knife Rush Slash
moves.description: Steady mid rush that cuts forward through long active slash frames.
moves.reason: The row shows a rushing slash/knife-like arc.

moves.label: Twin Muda Assault
moves.description: Slow mid string that steps in before a sweeping blade-like finish.
moves.reason: Multi-hit command builds into a wide curved strike.

moves.label: Vampire Cross Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher that snaps DIO upward into a rising hit.
moves.reason: The command is authored as launcher and has a lifting pose.

moves.label: Low Time Feint
moves.description: Steady low feint that flickers forward before DIO rises back up.
moves.reason: Low stance and afterimage frames support a deceptive low.

moves.label: Vampire Slide Trip
moves.description: Fast low knockdown that slides DIO across the floor into a trip.
moves.reason: Floor-level tumble and authored knockdown read as a sliding trip.

moves.label: The World Crush
moves.description: Slow mid tornado knockdown that flips through a committed power strike.
moves.reason: The move is authored as tornado/knockdown and visibly flips into crouch.

moves.label: Crouching Knife Sweep
moves.description: Fast mid crouch strike that snaps a curved slash from low posture.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route stays low and swings a curved hit effect.

moves.label: Crouch Muda Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that rises from crouch into a sweeping strike.
moves.reason: Crouch route is authored as launcher and rises into a slash.

moves.label: Charged Muda Jab
moves.description: Fast high charged jab with compact active timing.
moves.reason: Charge command reuses DIO's close jab silhouette.

moves.label: The World Drive
moves.description: Slow special knockdown that powers through with a heavy vampire rush.
moves.reason: Charge special and heavy advancing frames fit a Stand-powered drive.

moves.label: While-Rising Muda
moves.description: Slow mid while-standing strike that rises into a forward body blow.
moves.reason: While-standing frames lift DIO into a mid-height strike.

moves.label: Low-Step Muda Jab
moves.description: Fast high poke from a low command that still checks upper body.
moves.reason: The contact frames match the high jab.

moves.label: Vampire Knife Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that winds up into a heavy curved slash.
moves.reason: d/f command is authored as launcher and ends in a large curved hit.

moves.label: Forward Muda Check
moves.description: Slow mid forward check with a committed step-in strike.
moves.reason: Forward command is a short advancing mid poke.

moves.label: Muda Dash Jab
moves.description: Fast high motion jab with a compact active window.
moves.reason: qcf route reuses the high jab contact frames.

moves.label: Time Stop Burst
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown that rushes forward before a dramatic flipping finish.
moves.reason: The finisher dives and flips through a heavy authored knockdown.
